title: StrategyConfigCreateResult
description: Phase I-1b (operator-account-onboarding): terminal outcome of StrategyConfigCreateWorkflow. The activity CATCHES each StrategyConfigWriter exception and coarsens it into the `outcome` enum (writer exception messages never surface to the client). api-gateway maps outcome to an HTTP status (CREATED 200, ALREADY_EXISTS 409, REJECTED_INVALID 400). Only genuinely transient/unknown faults (an IllegalStateException, e.g. a serialization fault) are NOT coarsened — they propagate as a retryable activity failure, surfacing as 503 (create disposition unknown, NEVER reported as success).

outcome.description: Controlled disposition of the create. CREATED: the row was inserted at version 1 (created_version set). ALREADY_EXISTS: a row already existed for (tenant, strategy) — the INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING affected zero rows (RowAlreadyExistsException). REJECTED_INVALID: the proposed config is malformed / fails live-required gates / its tenant_id|strategy_id does not match the create target (InvalidConfigException).

created_version.description: Set ONLY on CREATED: the persisted version (always 1 for a fresh row). Null/omitted on every other outcome.
